haiku-low.q1: Sign-in still works. Lookup is by google_sub only, so a changed Google email changes nothing stored.
haiku-low.q2: The user must enter that account's password on the confirm form, correctly and while not locked. Then the link row is inserted and a session starts.
haiku-low.q3: Each wrong password adds one failed login and keeps the pending record. At the fifth, the account locks for 15 minutes and the pending record is deleted, so no link is made.
haiku-low.q4: A verified unmatched email creates a new user with no password and a Google link in one transaction, then starts a session. An unverified email is refused at the login page, with nothing created.
haiku-low.q5: Both get the error page with nothing changed. The state expires after 10 minutes, and a reused state was already consumed by GETDEL.
haiku-low.q6: It creates the same sessions row and sid cookie as password login. What happens to an existing sid cookie is NOT STATED.
haiku-low.q7: Neither a password nor an email match is required. The signed-in session user must match the stored user_id. If the Google account is linked to another user, Settings refuses and nothing changes.
haiku-low.q8: State, nonce and code_verifier are in Redis key oidc:state:<sha256(state)>, and the binding value is in the oidc_bind cookie. The callback deletes them with GETDEL, or the 600 s TTL removes them.
haiku-low.q9: It is held in Redis oidc:pending:<id>, holding Google sub, target user_id and next. The browser refers to it by the oidc_pending cookie. It is deleted on link, lock, Cancel, refusal, or 600 s TTL.
haiku-low.q10: In the PostgreSQL table user_google_accounts. user_id is its primary key, giving one Google account per user. google_sub is UNIQUE, giving one user per Google account.
haiku-low.q11: The user is sent back to the origin page with 'Could not complete Google sign-in, try again'. Nothing changes. The exchange is not retried, and the cause is logged server-side.
haiku-low.q12: The mode (login or link) is stored in the Redis state record and read by GETDEL. Link mode requires the signed-in session user_id to equal the user_id stored at start.

sonnet.q1: Nothing changes. Lookup is by google_sub only (no email stored), so the changed email is irrelevant. They sign in normally and get start_session.
sonnet.q2: They must enter the existing account's password in a confirmation form (oidc:pending record, shown with Cancel). Only on a correct password is the link row inserted, then start_session is called.
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins and the form is shown again with a generic message; the pending record is kept with the same expiry. On the fifth wrong password locked_until = now + 15 min (failed_logins reset to 0), 'Account temporarily locked' is shown, the pending record is deleted and the cookie cleared, and nothing is linked.
sonnet.q4: If email_verified is true and no user matches, one transaction inserts a new user (password_hash NULL, email_verified_at now) plus a user_google_accounts row, then start_session. If email is not verified (and sub unlinked), it is refused: back to the login page with 'use email and password', and nothing is created.
sonnet.q5: Both give the error page. The state is unknown (expired after 10 min) or already used, so nothing is changed or created. (Reused callback: the state was consumed by GETDEL on the first callback.)
sonnet.q6: The same session as a password login: start_session(user_id) creates the sessions row and sid cookie, then redirects to the sanitized next or /home. NOT STATED what happens to a sid cookie the browser already had.
sonnet.q7: No password and no email match is needed; email and email_verified are ignored. The session user must equal the user_id stored at start (otherwise error page), and no start_session is called. If that sub is already linked to a different user: back to Settings with 'already linked to another account', nothing changed.
sonnet.q8: In Redis key oidc:state:<sha256(state)> (code_verifier, nonce, mode, user_id for link, binding value, sanitized next), with a 600 s TTL. The callback removes it with an atomic GETDEL; the TTL removes it if no callback arrives.
sonnet.q9: In Redis key oidc:pending:<id> holding the Google sub, target user_id and sanitized next. The browser refers to it through the oidc_pending cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax) holding the id. It is deleted on successful link, account lock, Cancel, refused outcomes at confirm, or after the 600 s TTL (wrong passwords don't extend it).
sonnet.q10: In PostgreSQL table user_google_accounts (user_id, google_sub, linked_at). user_id PRIMARY KEY enforces one Google account per user; google_sub UNIQUE enforces one user per Google account.
sonnet.q11: The user is redirected back to the origin page (login or Settings) with 'Could not complete Google sign-in, try again'. Nothing changes. The exchange is not retried, because the state is already consumed; the cause is logged server-side.
sonnet.q12: The callback reads the mode (login or link) stored in the Redis state record. For link, the user_id is stored in the state at start, and the callback requires a signed-in session whose user equals that stored user_id; otherwise it shows the error page.
